targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM inventory.servers WHERE server_key IN ('dc-chicago-rack-01-srv-01','dc-chicago-rack-01-srv-02','dc-london-rack-01-srv-01','dc-london-rack-01-srv-02','dc-singapore-rack-01-srv-01','dc-singapore-rack-01-srv-02','dc-mumbai-rack-01-srv-01','dc-mumbai-rack-01-srv-02') AND (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR server_key LIKE ${site:sqlstring}||'-%')

SELECT count(*) AS value FROM ingestion.source_events WHERE topic='server.metrics' AND source_system LIKE 'dc-%-node-exporter' AND asset_id IN ('dc-chicago-rack-01-srv-01','dc-chicago-rack-01-srv-02','dc-london-rack-01-srv-01','dc-london-rack-01-srv-02','dc-singapore-rack-01-srv-01','dc-singapore-rack-01-srv-02','dc-mumbai-rack-01-srv-01','dc-mumbai-rack-01-srv-02') AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR site_id=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${server:sqlstring}='All' OR asset_id=${server:sqlstring})

SELECT count(*) AS value FROM (SELECT asset_id,max(received_at) last_seen FROM ingestion.source_events WHERE topic='server.metrics' AND source_system LIKE 'dc-%-node-exporter' AND asset_id IN ('dc-chicago-rack-01-srv-01','dc-chicago-rack-01-srv-02','dc-london-rack-01-srv-01','dc-london-rack-01-srv-02','dc-singapore-rack-01-srv-01','dc-singapore-rack-01-srv-02','dc-mumbai-rack-01-srv-01','dc-mumbai-rack-01-srv-02') AND (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR site_id=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${server:sqlstring}='All' OR asset_id=${server:sqlstring}) GROUP BY asset_id) x WHERE last_seen>=now()-interval '20 minutes'

SELECT count(DISTINCT vm_key) AS value FROM telemetry.vm_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at) AND (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR vm_key LIKE ${site:sqlstring}||'-%') AND (${server:sqlstring}='All' OR vm_key LIKE ${server:sqlstring}||'-vm-%')

SELECT observed_at AS time,server_key AS metric,cpu_utilization_percent AS value FROM telemetry.server_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at) AND server_key IN ('dc-chicago-rack-01-srv-01','dc-chicago-rack-01-srv-02','dc-london-rack-01-srv-01','dc-london-rack-01-srv-02','dc-singapore-rack-01-srv-01','dc-singapore-rack-01-srv-02','dc-mumbai-rack-01-srv-01','dc-mumbai-rack-01-srv-02') AND (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR server_key LIKE ${site:sqlstring}||'-%') AND (${server:sqlstring}='All' OR server_key=${server:sqlstring}) ORDER BY observed_at

SELECT observed_at AS time,server_key AS metric,memory_utilization_percent AS value FROM telemetry.server_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at) AND server_key IN ('dc-chicago-rack-01-srv-01','dc-chicago-rack-01-srv-02','dc-london-rack-01-srv-01','dc-london-rack-01-srv-02','dc-singapore-rack-01-srv-01','dc-singapore-rack-01-srv-02','dc-mumbai-rack-01-srv-01','dc-mumbai-rack-01-srv-02') AND (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR server_key LIKE ${site:sqlstring}||'-%') AND (${server:sqlstring}='All' OR server_key=${server:sqlstring}) ORDER BY observed_at

SELECT observed_at AS time,server_key AS metric,disk_utilization_percent AS value FROM telemetry.server_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at) AND server_key IN ('dc-chicago-rack-01-srv-01','dc-chicago-rack-01-srv-02','dc-london-rack-01-srv-01','dc-london-rack-01-srv-02','dc-singapore-rack-01-srv-01','dc-singapore-rack-01-srv-02','dc-mumbai-rack-01-srv-01','dc-mumbai-rack-01-srv-02') AND (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR server_key LIKE ${site:sqlstring}||'-%') AND (${server:sqlstring}='All' OR server_key=${server:sqlstring}) ORDER BY observed_at

SELECT observed_at AS time,server_key AS metric,network_latency_ms AS value FROM telemetry.server_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at) AND server_key IN ('dc-chicago-rack-01-srv-01','dc-chicago-rack-01-srv-02','dc-london-rack-01-srv-01','dc-london-rack-01-srv-02','dc-singapore-rack-01-srv-01','dc-singapore-rack-01-srv-02','dc-mumbai-rack-01-srv-01','dc-mumbai-rack-01-srv-02') AND (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR server_key LIKE ${site:sqlstring}||'-%') AND (${server:sqlstring}='All' OR server_key=${server:sqlstring}) ORDER BY observed_at

SELECT observed_at AS time,server_key AS metric,packet_loss_percent AS value FROM telemetry.server_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at) AND server_key IN ('dc-chicago-rack-01-srv-01','dc-chicago-rack-01-srv-02','dc-london-rack-01-srv-01','dc-london-rack-01-srv-02','dc-singapore-rack-01-srv-01','dc-singapore-rack-01-srv-02','dc-mumbai-rack-01-srv-01','dc-mumbai-rack-01-srv-02') AND (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR server_key LIKE ${site:sqlstring}||'-%') AND (${server:sqlstring}='All' OR server_key=${server:sqlstring}) ORDER BY observed_at

panels.title: Servers Receiving Simulated Kafka Data — click a row to open VMs

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.name AS "Data Center",s.site_key AS "Site Key",r.name AS "Rack",r.rack_key AS "Rack Key",sv.hostname AS "Server",sv.server_key AS "Server Key",sv.status AS "Status",sv.health_status AS "Health",round(lm.cpu_utilization_percent::numeric,1) AS "CPU %",round(lm.memory_utilization_percent::numeric,1) AS "Memory %",round(lm.disk_utilization_percent::numeric,1) AS "Disk %",round(lm.network_latency_ms::numeric,1) AS "Latency ms",round(lm.packet_loss_percent::numeric,2) AS "Packet Loss %",round(lm.temperature_celsius::numeric,1) AS "Temp °C",coalesce(ev.events,0) AS "Kafka Events",ev.last_received AS "Kafka Last Received",count(DISTINCT vm.id) AS "VMs",count(DISTINCT vmm.vm_id) AS "VMs With Telemetry" FROM inventory.servers sv JOIN inventory.racks r ON r.id=sv.rack_id JOIN inventory.data_center_rows dr ON dr.id=r.row_id JOIN inventory.rooms rm ON rm.id=dr.room_id JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=rm.site_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM telemetry.server_metrics m WHERE m.server_id=sv.id ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1) lm ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(*) events,max(received_at) last_received FROM ingestion.source_events e WHERE e.topic='server.metrics' AND e.asset_id=sv.server_key AND e.source_system LIKE 'dc-%-node-exporter' AND $__timeFilter(e.received_at)) ev ON true LEFT JOIN inventory.hypervisors h ON h.server_id=sv.id LEFT JOIN inventory.virtual_machines vm ON vm.hypervisor_id=h.id LEFT JOIN telemetry.vm_metrics vmm ON vmm.vm_id=vm.id AND $__timeFilter(vmm.observed_at) WHERE sv.server_key IN ('dc-chicago-rack-01-srv-01','dc-chicago-rack-01-srv-02','dc-london-rack-01-srv-01','dc-london-rack-01-srv-02','dc-singapore-rack-01-srv-01','dc-singapore-rack-01-srv-02','dc-mumbai-rack-01-srv-01','dc-mumbai-rack-01-srv-02') AND (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR s.site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${server:sqlstring}='All' OR sv.server_key=${server:sqlstring}) GROUP BY s.name,s.site_key,r.name,r.rack_key,sv.id,lm.cpu_utilization_percent,lm.memory_utilization_percent,lm.disk_utilization_percent,lm.network_latency_ms,lm.packet_loss_percent,lm.temperature_celsius,ev.events,ev.last_received ORDER BY s.name,sv.hostname

panels.title: Latest VM Telemetry for Selected Servers

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (m.vm_id) m.observed_at AS "Observed",s.site_key AS "Site",sv.server_key AS "Physical Server",vm.vm_key AS "VM",vm.status AS "Status",round(m.cpu_utilization_percent::numeric,1) AS "CPU %",round(m.memory_utilization_percent::numeric,1) AS "Memory %",round(m.storage_utilization_percent::numeric,1) AS "Storage %",round(m.uptime_percent::numeric,3) AS "Uptime %",m.source AS "Source" FROM telemetry.vm_metrics m JOIN inventory.virtual_machines vm ON vm.id=m.vm_id JOIN inventory.hypervisors h ON h.id=vm.hypervisor_id JOIN inventory.servers sv ON sv.id=h.server_id JOIN inventory.racks r ON r.id=sv.rack_id JOIN inventory.data_center_rows dr ON dr.id=r.row_id JOIN inventory.rooms rm ON rm.id=dr.room_id JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=rm.site_id WHERE $__timeFilter(m.observed_at) AND (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR s.site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${server:sqlstring}='All' OR sv.server_key=${server:sqlstring}) ORDER BY m.vm_id,m.observed_at DESC
